experiment.name: PG-CLIP v0.1
experiment.chinese: 原生对齐＋投影前 768 维文本条件视觉选择

training.precision: fp32 master weights; bf16 autocast for the visual/text transformers; the pre-projection core (native projection, conditional projection, final text projection, gate, normalise, scores, losses) is explicitly fp32
training.ddp_route: per-rank anchor means + autograd-aware gather + standard DDP parameter averaging; no world-size factor

stream_provenance.note: checked against /root/SAID-gap-completion/runs_salu/said_cls_cvssl/ddpfix_step500_S0_smartclip/run_summary.json; the data and caption streams are bit-identical, not merely seeded identically

evaluation.protocol: native CLS/EOS only: Normalize(encode_image(I)) and Normalize(encode_text(C)); the gate, any two-path fusion, any reranking and any auxiliary representation are unused

coco_canonical.protocol: 5000 images x 25000 captions, frozen canonical evaluator

urban1k.protocol: 1000 images x 1000 captions, upstream Urban-1k layout (image/ + caption/)

evaluation.gate: COCO I2T R@1 >= 0.6058 and T2I R@1 >= 0.41236, at least one strictly higher
evaluation.verdict_reason: COCO I2T R@1 = 0.6048 is 0.10 pp below the 0.6058 floor (one query of 5000); T2I R@1 = 0.41256 clears its floor by 0.02 pp, which is one query of 25000

attempt_history.failure_reason: checkpoint verification read the gate identity from the wrong key and compared a missing top-level lr_horizon_steps
the checkpoint carries no gate tensors (schema v1.0 key collision, see post_run_fixes)

post_run_fixes: the trainer wrote the gate TENSORS and the gate DESCRIPTION to the same checkpoint key, so the trained gate weights of the first production run were not persisted (fixed: gate tensors now live under gate_state; a regression test asserts both survive)
checkpoint schema v1.1 adds the flat gate identity keys and lr_horizon_steps so a verifier does not have to read them out of the config block

the runner now verifies the gate/clip tensor shapes and refuses to continue without --allow-missing-gate-state when a v1.0 checkpoint has no gate tensors; the primary evaluation never uses the gate, and the loss is recorded in run_status.json (gate_state_missing, gate_state_note)
no retraining was performed: the export and both evaluations were re-run on the existing step-500 checkpoint with --phases export,coco,urban

acceptance_tests.tests/test_pgclip.py: 16 passed (A extraction point and native-interface identity, B fully-open initialisation and the 10*LG gradient identity, C chunked scores vs a pair loop with the non-diagonal W@W.T counterexample, D mask semantics and gradient responsibility, E boundaries incl. an energy ratio above 1, F a real two-rank DDP step vs a single-process reference, G the real CLI, checkpoint round-trip and lossless bare-student export)

ddp_evidence.reading: the two routes are mathematically identical; the residual parameter difference is confined to gradient elements below ~1e-3, where AdamW's normalised first step turns a sign flip at the fp32 accumulation noise floor into a full +-lr move. No world-size factor is used anywhere.

acceptance_tests.dashboard: tests/test_training_dashboard.py 43 passed (incl. four PG-CLIP endpoint tests and the node render harness)
